description: Auto-emit one Dagster asset per JDE orchestration via the Orchestrator REST API. StateBackedComponent — discovery cached to disk, refreshed on explicit trigger. Materializing an asset executes the orchestration (sync or async) and polls to terminal state. The workspace-shape peer of the jde_orchestrator_* low-level components.

outputs.description: One Dagster asset per selected item discovered in the vendor. See README for what each materialization produces.

orchestration_selector.label: Orchestration Selector
orchestration_selector.description: Fivetran-shape selector: by_name / by_pattern / exclude_by_name / exclude_by_pattern.

group_name.description: Group name for all imported assets.
group_name.label: Group Name

asset_key_prefix.description: Key prefix used for all emitted AssetKeys.
asset_key_prefix.label: Asset Key Prefix

compute_kind.description: Compute kind tag for all imported assets.
compute_kind.label: Compute Kind

async_mode.description: If true, submit orchestrations with ``?asynchronous=true`` so AIS returns a jobId immediately. Pairs with ``wait_for_completion`` to poll the status endpoint until terminal.
async_mode.label: Async Mode

wait_for_completion.description: When ``async_mode`` is true, block on the AIS status endpoint until the orchestration reaches a terminal state (SUCCESS/COMPLETED/FAILED/ERROR/CANCELED). Ignored in synchronous mode.
wait_for_completion.label: Wait for Completion

poll_interval_seconds.description: How often (in seconds) to poll the AIS job-status endpoint in async mode.
poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval (s)

timeout_seconds.description: Overall deadline (seconds) for both the initial POST and the async job-status polling loop.
timeout_seconds.label: Timeout (s)

defs_state.description: State backend for cached workspace discovery. Local filesystem by default. Overridden per-deploy for prod runs against Dagster Cloud.
defs_state.label: Defs State Config
